## How to build

Building happens in a new Claude Code session so the interview does not fill the context.

```powershell
# PowerShell
cd "C:\projects\log-to-jira"; claude "Read CLAUDE.md, then follow PLAN.md from the first task that is not done."
```

```bash
# bash / Git Bash
cd "C:\projects\log-to-jira" && claude "Read CLAUDE.md, then follow PLAN.md from the first task that is not done."
```
